title: Hiden Isochema
content: Hiden Isochema is a United Kingdom instrumentation company focused on sorption analysis systems for porous materials research. Its product range includes gas and vapor sorption instruments used to study adsorption behavior, pore structure, and material performance in advanced porous solids. Hiden Isochema is relevant to aerogel laboratories and development teams that need characterization tools for adsorption, porosity, and related material science workflows.
